news.contents: Pittsburgh Steelers running back Rico Dowdle led the backfield with a 49% snap share in Week 10 against the Cincinnati Bengals, but that didn't automatically result in a strong fantasy performance. The 28-year-old rushed for just 26 yards on five carries, and he added just two catches for eight receiving yards. news.analysis: Flowers was able to put up a respectable performance on Monday night. He finished with six catches for 74 yards, which left him with a decent fantasy total in PPR formats. His game-to-game outlook may be rocky moving forward, however, as fantasy managers can't expect QB Jacoby Brissett to continue to attempt 49 passes per game over the back half of the season.
